svg.title: Decision matrix: cost of being wrong versus ambiguity
svg.desc: A two by two matrix. Low ambiguity and low cost of error uses the Fast tier. High ambiguity and high cost uses the Strong tier with a human gate.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
